environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28, pod runs in namespace 'order-processing' with hostNetwork: false. Pod uses IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) for SQS access. No NetworkPolicy objects exist in the namespace. Node IMDSv2 is enabled but hop limit is set to 2 (default for EKS nodes), allowing pod-level access to IMDS. The pod has 4 replicas with SQS FIFO queue but visibility timeout race allows duplicate consumption.
